title: Commands by shape
description:
Write `respond(words)` with one `match` statement. `words` is a list of strings, such as `"go north".split()`:

| Words | Result |
|---|---|
| `["look"]` | `"You look around."` |
| `["go", direction]` where direction is north, south, east or west | `"You go <direction>."` |
| `["go", anything else]` | `"You cannot go <that>."` |
| `["take", item]` | `"Taken: <item>."` |
| `["take", first, *more]` | `"Taken: <all of them joined by ', '>."` |
| `["quit"]` or `["exit"]` | `"Bye."` |
| `[]` | `"Say something."` |
| anything else | `"I do not understand."` |

solution.solution.py:
def respond(words):
    match words:
        case ["look"]:
            return "You look around."
        case ["go", "north" | "south" | "east" | "west" as direction]:
            return f"You go {direction}."
        case ["go", other]:
            return f"You cannot go {other}."
        case ["take", item]:
            return f"Taken: {item}."
        case ["take", first, *more]:
            return "Taken: " + ", ".join([first, *more]) + "."
        case ["quit"] | ["exit"]:
            return "Bye."
        case []:
            return "Say something."
        case _:
            return "I do not understand."

hints: `"north" | "south" | "east" | "west" as direction` matches any of the four and binds the one that matched.
Order matters: the `["go", direction]` case with the four names must come before the general `["go", other]` case.
